title: The Hughes group's CIA covert actions, the Glomar Explorer and the Kennedy killings

tellings.quote: And this was the same group that was doing all the covert actions for the CIA, the Lamar Explorer, etc. And potentially even doing the hits

plain: A group around the businessman Howard Hughes did the CIA's covert work in the 1960s and 70s, including the project known as the Glomar Explorer, and may even have carried out "the hits", meaning the Kennedy killings, says the researcher Matthew Pines. Pines tells Michels this without naming a source. He brings it up because he ties the same group to the hidden UFO story, which would put a private network at the centre of both secret operations and political murders.
